verdicts.title: Influencing elections with statistics: Targeting voters with logistic regression trees
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In political campaigning substantial resources are spent on voter mobilization, that is, on identifying and influencing as many people as possible to vote. verdicts.title: Test ideals via algebras of $p^{-e}$-linear maps
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
Continuing ideas of a recent preprint of Schwede arXiv:0906.4313 we study test ideals by viewing them as minimal objects in a certain class of $F$-pure modules over algebras of p^{-e}-linear operators.
